title: South Indian Filter Coffee
description: Frothy, strong decoction coffee mixed with hot sweetened milk and poured between steel tumblers.
steps: Put the coffee powder in the upper chamber of a filter and pour over 150 ml of boiling water.
Cover and let the decoction drip for 10 to 15 minutes.
Heat the milk until it just boils.
Add the sugar to each tumbler with 2 tbsp of the decoction per cup, or more for a stronger brew.
Top with hot milk and pour between two tumblers a few times to froth before serving.
